_meta.description: Per-layer functional roles and steering parameters for Qwen3-0.6B (28 transformer layers). Residual/vector norms from diagnose_steering.py; word counts from sweep at alpha=2.0 (CPRR conjecture 27). Roles synthesized from probing literature + empirical steering behavior.
sources: Dang & Ngo 2026 — Selective Steering layer selection
Hegazy 2025 — Guiding Giants learned layer weights
Sinii 2025 — Small Vectors Big Effects mechanistic study

regions.name: tokenization
regions.role: Token embedding refinement, positional encoding integration
regions.encodes: subword identity, position, basic token co-occurrence
regions.steering_effect: Catastrophic — corrupts token-level representations, produces gibberish or language-switching
regions.evidence: H-LS-3: layers 0-7 produce topic drift not style shift

regions.name: syntax
regions.role: Syntactic structure, phrase boundaries, grammatical relations
regions.encodes: POS tags, dependency structure, agreement features, basic word order
regions.steering_effect: Topic drift, ungrammatical output, language contamination. Steering here changes WHAT is said, not HOW.
regions.evidence: H-LS-3; Geva 2021 lower layers as syntactic key-value stores

regions.name: early_semantics
regions.role: Semantic composition, entity recognition, basic concept formation
regions.encodes: Word sense disambiguation, entity types, semantic roles, basic factual associations
regions.steering_effect: Marginal style effect, some content blending. Layer 10 shows terse effect (23 words at alpha=2.0) but with semantic artifacts.
regions.evidence: Conjecture 27: layer 10 = 23 words but quality concerns; Meng 2022 early-mid causal tracing

regions.name: deep_semantics
regions.role: Abstract concept representation, style encoding, behavioral conditioning
regions.encodes: Tone, verbosity, formality, persona traits, reasoning depth, conceptual relationships
regions.steering_effect: Strong, clean style modulation. This is where contrastive vectors produce intended behavioral shifts with minimal side effects.
regions.evidence: Conjecture 27: L12=16w, L14=29w, L16=48w at alpha=2.0; BEST_LAYER=12; SWEET_SPOT_RANGE=(12,18)

regions.name: output_preparation
regions.role: Output formatting, task-specific features, response structure
regions.encodes: Markdown formatting, list vs prose decisions, code block boundaries, response length planning
regions.steering_effect: Diminishing style effect, increasing formatting artifacts. Steering here changes surface presentation more than underlying style.
regions.evidence: Conjecture 27: L18=169w, L20=174w (near baseline); residual norms rising sharply (538→595)

regions.name: logit_projection
regions.encodes: Token probabilities, final vocabulary selection, repetition avoidance
regions.steering_effect: Vocabulary-level distortion. Can force specific tokens but destroys coherent style modulation. Very high vec norms (70.8 at L24) make calibration fragile.
regions.evidence: RAW_VEC_NORM L24=70.8, residual norm=810; SNR=8.7% (unstable territory)

single_layer_terse.description: Simplest approach: one hook at best layer
single_layer_terse.risk: Some semantic drift at high alpha

two_layer_balanced.risk: Lower peak compression but more natural output

three_layer_gradient.risk: Requires per-layer vector computation (3 captures instead of 1)

full_repE.layers: all 28, each with own vector and alpha
full_repE.calibration: Requires corpus of 50+ paired examples per layer for stable directions
full_repE.alpha_rule: Target SNR 3-5% at each layer: alpha = 0.04 * residual_norm / raw_vec_norm
full_repE.risk: Calibration cost; diminishing returns below layer 8 and above layer 22

test_protocol.description: Scorecard for characterizing what each layer encodes, runnable as a sweep

probes.name: syntactic_integrity
probes.method: Parse steered output with spaCy; measure dependency parse accuracy vs baseline

probes.name: topic_preservation
probes.method: Cosine similarity of TF-IDF vectors between steered and baseline outputs

probes.name: style_shift
probes.method: Word count ratio, words-per-sentence, hedging ratio, type-token ratio (from test_style_contracts.py)

probes.name: formatting_artifacts
probes.method: Count markdown tokens (**, ##, ```, -) in output; ratio vs baseline

probes.name: vocabulary_distortion
probes.method: Perplexity under unsteered model; KL divergence of token distributions

probes.name: lens_contamination
probes.method: Run lens_eval.py 12-lens battery; measure per-lens delta from baseline

references: Dang & Ngo 2026 — Selective Steering: discriminative layer selection via norm-preserving rotation
Sharma 2025 — G-ACT: per-layer probe classification accuracy as layer selection signal
Hegazy 2025 — Guiding Giants: learned controller network outputs per-layer alpha weights
Sinii 2025 — Small Vectors Big Effects: logit-lens + path-patching per layer
